svg.title: The free index lags the reporters: 2.4% of real citations can't be looked up

cc:Work.dc:title: The free index lags the reporters: 2.4% of real citations can't be looked up
cc:Work.dc:description: Of 755 citations, 735 resolved, 18 real but unindexed, 2 wrong page. So. 3d pagination absent from free sources after vol. ~277 (2019).

g.text: 18 real cases, not in the free index (2.4% of all cites, 95% CI 1.5%–3.7%)

g.text: So. 3d pagination absent from free sources after vol. ~277 (2019). 17 of the 18 were decided 2018–2022.

g.text: A free citation lookup answers these 18 real cases exactly as it answers an invented one: "not found".
